_meta.step: dev0934 — step 3: the menu pages, the quiz, the sign-in strip
_meta.how: The KEY is the English string exactly as it appears in the code. T('Grids') looks up 'Grids' here. A missing key, or an EMPTY value, falls back to English — so a blank line below is a to-do, never a bug, and deleting an entry is a safe no-op.
_meta.sections: Section names are for humans only. lang.js flattens them into one map at load, so a string can be moved between sections without breaking anything. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_meta.markup: A value may carry HTML where the English did (the hamburger items). Keep any markup the English key has, or drop it deliberately — the <u>X</u> hotkey underlines are dropped here on purpose: the letters are English mnemonics, they are dev-facing, and underlining a letter that is not in the Spanish word is worse than no underline.
_meta.notreached: NOT translated: the H help panel (HELP_DATA in core.js + the hotkeys.js registry), the dev screens (T/A/E/D/Xe/I/St/O/X/LLC), and ml.json VidTitle and comment. ftext IS now translatable — dev0933 added ftext.es.json, a per-UID sidecar covering the FlashTry1 cards, and every viewer-facing render reads it through salFtext(row). This dictionary stays the place for CHROME; a row’s own prose belongs in that file, and a MENU PAGE’s prose (a c.json ctxt) belongs in ctxt.es.json, added in dev0934 on the same read-only-sidecar pattern.

_quiz: (dev0934) The quiz that runs on a flash-card grid (quizcells.js). The Quiz/Exit button, the hint offer, and the whole end-of-run summary. The species names inside the summary are NOT here: a scientific name is the same in every language, and a card's common name comes from ftext.es.json through the card's own prose.

quiz.click anywhere on screen to dismiss: haz clic en cualquier parte de la pantalla para cerrar

_auth: (dev0934) The sign-in strip, which is the visible body of the Contact tab. 'Signed in as {who}' keeps its placeholder — the name is substituted after lookup, so the translation chooses where it goes. The dev-mode message is not here: it never reaches a viewer.

auth.Could not reach the server. Please try a: No se pudo contactar con el servidor. Inténtalo de nuevo.

_reader: (dev0933) The chrome the V reader prints AROUND a text slide. The card prose itself is not here — it lives in ftext.es.json, keyed by ml.json UID. These four keys are the frame that used to stay stubbornly English while the slide inside it turned Spanish.

reader.▶▶ Hide all · or double click off deta: ▶▶ Ocultar todo  ·  o doble clic fuera de una línea desplegable
reader.Esc / swipe ← on this bar to return: Esc / desliza ← en esta barra para volver

_cardbacks: The note and the one-line description on a card back come from taxoninfo.es.json and are already Spanish. What follows is the FURNITURE printed around them — the rank word and the IUCN status — which are vocabularies, not prose, and are matched here as whole lowercase strings exactly as tags.json and taxoninfo.json store them.
